customer: Hi, so I'm a grad student in Eastvale and I just sold my hybrid sedan to Northwind, which honestly is a relief because money's tight with tuition and everything. My next car payment is due in a few days, and I'm wondering whether I should just skip it since you're paying off the loan anyway? I really don't want to pay twice if I can avoid it, but I also don't want to mess anything up.
agent: Thanks for checking before skipping it! According to our article 'Should I keep making loan payments?', you should keep making your regular loan payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off. Our payoff covers the amount your lender quoted, and a missed payment in the meantime can be reported as late on your credit history. If a payment goes through after the payoff, your lender will refund it to you, as explained in 'Getting back an extra loan payment.'
